# SOP extract — AP-004 Invoice Processing (rev. 2024-11)

Provided by the Corporate Controller as the current written procedure.
Extract covers sections 3 through 6 only.

## 3. Receipt and capture

3.1 All supplier invoices shall be directed to the designated accounts
payable electronic mailbox. Invoices received in hard copy shall be scanned
on the day of receipt.

3.2 All invoice images shall be processed through the document capture
application. The extraction confidence threshold shall be set at ninety
percent (90%). Documents scoring below the threshold shall be routed to the
manual validation queue and keyed by the Accounts Payable Clerk.

3.3 Duplicate submission shall be prevented by the enterprise resource
planning system's unique constraint on supplier identifier and supplier
invoice number.

## 4. Three-way match

4.1 Purchase-order-backed invoices shall be matched to the purchase order
line and the item receipt prior to approval for payment.

4.2 Quantity and price variances within tolerance shall release
automatically. The tolerance shall not exceed two percent (2%) of extended
line value.

4.3 Variances exceeding tolerance shall be placed on hold pending
disposition.

## 5. Exception disposition

5.1 Held invoices shall be dispositioned by the Accounts Payable Manager,
who shall record a reason code for each disposition.

5.2 Capture exceptions arising in the document capture application are
administered by the Accounts Payable Clerk under section 3 and are not
invoice processing exceptions for the purposes of this section.

## 6. Records

6.1 The reason code log shall be retained in the enterprise resource
planning system for seven years.
